record.title: Explain synthetic walkthrough operations as they execute
record.intent: Let readers follow public CLI commands and expected outcomes without tracing shell plumbing.
requirements: Show a purpose label, actual CLI command, report destination and actual versus expected exit status for each evidence or review operation.
Keep glue quiet and preserve report bytes, expected rejection checks and refusal to reuse output directories.
Add focused source-contract pointers and document the terminal output convention.
Verify the existing walkthrough controls and a fresh manual run, then commit and push.
acceptance: A reader can follow all five CLI operations and distinguish intended rejection from unexpected failure.
